note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; source types are shown as stated by the witness, never assessed.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional statement: the witness states two things as seen and one as heard from a neighbour; the clerk writes each on a labelled card and lines them up beside the witness.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: two statements, the first received from a named person and the second observed; the last card stays held up for read-back (supplied final state); different people.

facts.text: The shop shutter was already half open
A cyclist waited under the street lamp

annotations.text: The written account stays with the witness

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, long role captions, three long statements with long source labels and a long origin, long document title and two callouts.

facts.text: A dark blue delivery van parked beside the north gate of the warehouse yard
Two people in grey jackets carried several cardboard boxes into the building
The same delivery van drove away from the yard some time before midnight
facts.via: the neighbour from the third floor

sourceLabels.received: information received, as the witness stated it
